# one LTL formula per line; '#' starts a comment
# '# group: <name>' labels the formulas that follow
# a trailing '# SAT' / '# UNSAT' records the expected verdict

# group: propositional
a    # SAT
a && !a    # UNSAT
a || !a    # SAT

# group: tautology
a -> a    # SAT
[]a -> a    # SAT
[](a -> b) -> ([]a -> []b)    # SAT

# group: contradiction
!(a -> a)    # UNSAT

# group: future
[]a    # SAT
<>a    # SAT
<>!a    # UNSAT
[]<>a    # SAT
<>[]a    # SAT
X X X a    # SAT
a U b    # SAT
a W b    # SAT
[](a -> <>b)    # SAT
[](a -> X b)    # SAT
[]a && <>b    # UNSAT
(a U b) && []!b    # UNSAT
[](a -> <>b) && []<>a && []!b    # UNSAT
[](a -> X(b U c)) && []<>a && []!c    # UNSAT
<>(a && X b) && [](b -> X c)    # SAT
[]<>(a -> X(b U c))    # SAT

# group: future big
(((a U b) U c) U d)    # SAT
[]<>a && []<>b && []<>c    # SAT
[]<>a && []<>b && []<>c && []<>d    # SAT

# group: past
<*>a    # SAT
[*]a    # SAT
Y a    # UNSAT
Y a -> <*>a    # SAT
a S b    # SAT
<*>a && !a    # UNSAT
[*]!a && <*>a    # UNSAT
<*>(a && Y b)    # UNSAT
Y Y Y Y a    # UNSAT
<*><*><*>a    # SAT
[](b -> <*>a)    # SAT
[](b -> Y a)    # SAT
[](b -> <*>a) && b    # UNSAT
[](b -> (a S c))    # SAT

# group: past big
[](a -> <*>(b && Y c))    # SAT
[]<>a && [](a -> <*>b)    # SAT
[]<>a && []<>b && [](a -> <*>b) && [](b -> <*>c)    # SAT
